text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking I heard King Halo's voice from 
inside the ramen shop, I peeked in...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-ray! Hoo-ray! S-p-e-san! 
Hoo-raaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Puhaah! Thanks for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! You've cleared the 
Mega-Portion Challenge!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The cheering at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival was wicked passionate! I actually 
teared up a little...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! Such thrilling, powerful cheering...! 
El would love to be cheered on like that 
at least once, yes!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu! Well, though I truly am that 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The King shall step up to 
the plate and cheer everyone on as well! 
You should be grateful!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Us too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Apparently, that's what happened. And 
so King Halo decided she would go around 
cheering for all of them."
choice_data_list:
You even wore the outfit—talk about 
motivated!

You even wore the outfit—talk about 
motivated!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! If King is going to cheer for 
you, it has to be first-class cheering!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This is an outfit that King herself 
designed to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's absolutely essential for first-rate 
cheering!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's move on to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somehow I ended up tagging along... but 
either way, I was worried, so I decided to 
follow as told.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hoo-ray! Hoo-ray! S-k-y-san! Do your best! 
Do your b—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Could you cheer toward that big rock 
over there for a bit?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Eh, on that rock...? I don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best! Hang in there, S-k-y-san! 
Hip, hip, hooray!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
King, you made it! Come on, cheer on Mambo 
together with El, desu!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Mambo? Wait, who's that?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mambo! Land that somersault next time, 
*desu*!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I don't know who you are, but! Do 
your best! Hang in there! M-a-n-b-o--!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Such considerate cheering suited to the 
occasion... Thank you for your 
thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Then, I shall arrange today's 
flowers with that cheering in mind...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Going around to cheer for 
everyone is quite a handful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is nothing to me! It's 
a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, wasn't King's first-rate 
cheering absolutely magnificent?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
King Halo is full of confidence, but the 
ones who cheered her on felt like rocks 
and flowers... I hope the message got 
through properly—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am so very grateful, yes! It seems she 
took a liking to that cheering tempo, and 
really got the hang of it, yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was able to arrange the flowers from a 
whole new perspective. May I ask for your 
help again sometime~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The fish in the rocky shallows come out, 
too. It's fun. Well, having a lively time 
once in a while isn't bad at all~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! Thanks to King-chan's cheering, I 
devoured the noodles at crazy speed...! 
And cleared the mega-portion ramen!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you're ever in trouble, just say the 
word, King-chan! We'll be cheering our 
hearts out for you too, you betcha!
choice_data_list: You did it, it's a huge success!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
! ...H-Hmph! A King is always flawless, so 
your concern is unnecessary!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'll give you credit for realizing 
King's greatness!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Tell me whenever you need my cheers again. 
If I'm in the mood, I might just root for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Big talk for someone with a bright red 
face~♪ Ah, is that you trying to hide your 
embarrassment~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Tough luck, I'm not falling for that 
bait!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
King was merely reflecting upon her own 
greatness once again, you know!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite saying so, King Halo looked 
remarkably delighted.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It just looks that way because of the 
sunset! This much is completely natural 
for me anyway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that's what she says, I'll just blame 
the redness of her cheeks on the sunset.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Dummy! I'm not blushing! I'm just deeply 
moved—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, that way, huh~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! I didn't say anything! Hey, 
what are you guys laughing at?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, King Halo remained as stubborn and 
dishonest with her feelings as ever.
